## Complete Example

### Prerequisites

1. Install Visual Studio
2. Create new project
3. Add Aspose.Slides reference

### Code Sample

- **Initialize**: Create Presentation object
- **Process**: Add or modify slides
- **Save**: Export to desired format

See [API Reference](https://reference.aspose.net/) for details.

Use `Presentation` class from Aspose.Slides namespace.
